about: Canonical accessibility setting keys shared by every engine sample. A game copies only the entries its signals require (see ACCESSIBILITY.md). 'catalog' lists option IDs from references/option-catalog.md; 'signals' lists signal IDs from references/signal-routing.md ('baseline' = assess in every game). Defaults are the designer's intended value except where core-policy.md section 3 requires a safe default. Labels/descriptions are plain-language English source strings; localise them via keys in your project.

presets.label: Sound shown as text and visuals

settings.label: Text size
settings.description: Scales all menu, HUD and dialogue text. Layouts reflow; nothing is clipped.

settings.label: Font
settings.description: Switches to a plain, high-legibility font or a dyslexia-friendly font. A reading preference, not a medical treatment.

settings.label: Line spacing
settings.description: Adds space between lines of text.

settings.label: Text background
settings.description: Opacity of the panel behind dialogue, tooltips and prompts. 100% is fully solid.

settings.label: Text reveal
settings.description: How quickly dialogue text appears. Instant shows the whole line at once.

settings.label: Auto-advance dialogue
settings.description: When off, dialogue waits for you to continue.

settings.label: Subtitles
settings.description: Shows text for all spoken dialogue, including radio and background speech.

settings.label: Sound captions
settings.description: Describes important sounds in text, for example [Alarm, left] or [Footsteps behind you].

settings.label: Speaker names
settings.description: Shows who is speaking before each subtitle.

settings.label: Speaker direction
settings.description: Adds an arrow or word showing where an off-screen voice or sound comes from.

settings.label: Subtitle size
settings.description: Scales subtitles independently from other text.

settings.label: Subtitle background
settings.description: Opacity of the box behind subtitles. 100% is fully solid.

settings.label: Master volume
settings.description: Overall volume. Starts quiet on first launch.

settings.label: Music volume
settings.description: Volume of music only. Important sound cues are not on this channel.

settings.label: Effects volume
settings.description: Volume of sound effects.

settings.label: Dialogue volume
settings.description: Volume of spoken dialogue.

settings.label: Ambience volume
settings.description: Volume of background environment sound.

settings.label: Mono audio
settings.description: Plays the same sound in both ears. Direction is still shown by visual cues if sound visualiser is on.

settings.label: Reduce sudden loud sounds
settings.description: Compresses peaks such as explosions, stings and screams.

settings.label: Sound visualiser
settings.description: Shows on-screen indicators for important sounds and their direction.

settings.label: Colour profile
settings.description: Recolours important game colours (teams, hazards, items) to sets that are easier to tell apart. Custom uses your own colours. Symbols and labels are always shown as well.

settings.label: Custom colours
settings.description: Your colour for each game colour role when Colour profile is Custom, as role=#RRGGBB pairs separated by semicolons.

settings.label: High-contrast outlines (all)
settings.description: Adds strong outlines to enemies, allies, interactive objects and hazards together. Each class can be overridden below.

settings.label: Enemy outlines
settings.description: Outline on enemies. 'Follow' uses the overall outline setting.

settings.label: Ally outlines
settings.description: Outline on allies and companions. 'Follow' uses the overall outline setting.

settings.label: Interactive object outlines
settings.description: Outline on objects you can use or pick up. 'Follow' uses the overall outline setting.

settings.label: Hazard and edge outlines
settings.description: Outline on hazards, ledges and platform edges. 'Follow' uses the overall outline setting.

settings.label: Dim background
settings.description: Darkens the background behind characters, hazards and interactive objects so they stand out.

settings.label: Interface size
settings.description: Scales HUD icons, buttons and cursor.

settings.label: Brightness
settings.description: Adjusts overall brightness for dark or glaring scenes.

settings.label: Camera shake
settings.description: Strength of screen shake from impacts and explosions, including cutscenes. 0% removes it completely.

settings.label: Head bob
settings.description: Strength of camera bobbing while walking or running. 0% removes it.

settings.label: Weapon sway
settings.description: Visual sway and breathing motion of held items. 0% removes it. Aim accuracy is unaffected.

settings.label: Motion blur
settings.description: Blur from fast camera or object movement.

settings.label: Field of view
settings.description: How wide the camera view is (vertical degrees). Wider can reduce motion sickness for some players.

settings.label: Reduce motion (all)
settings.description: Stops decorative and automatic motion together: animated menus, parallax, speed lines, zoom pulses and automatic camera swings. Each can be overridden below.

settings.label: Automatic camera movement
settings.description: Automatic recentring and camera rotation. 'Off' keeps the camera where you put it. 'Follow' uses Reduce motion.

settings.label: Dynamic field-of-view effects
settings.description: Field-of-view changes when sprinting, aiming or boosting. 'Follow' uses Reduce motion.

settings.label: Speed lines and radial blur
settings.description: Streaks and radial blur at high speed. 'Follow' uses Reduce motion.

settings.label: Parallax and background scrolling
settings.description: Background layers that move at different speeds. 'Follow' uses Reduce motion.

settings.label: Menu animation
settings.description: Animated menu backgrounds and UI transitions. 'Off' shows static menus and instant transitions. 'Follow' uses Reduce motion.

settings.label: Reduce flashing
settings.description: Replaces flashes (hits, lightning, muzzle flashes, transitions) with steady, gentler effects. The game avoids hazardous flashing even when this is off.

settings.label: Screen overlays
settings.description: Strength of vignette, damage overlays and distortion. 0% removes them; important information is shown another way.

settings.label: Chromatic aberration
settings.description: Colour fringing at the edges of the screen.

settings.label: Depth of field
settings.description: Background and foreground blur when focusing. Off keeps everything sharp.

settings.label: Guidance highlights (all)
settings.description: Sets painted ledges, glowing trails and interaction highlights together. Each can be overridden below. 'On request' shows them only when you press the hint button. Hazard warnings are never hidden.

settings.label: Painted ledges and paths
settings.description: Paint or markings on climbable ledges and routes. 'Follow' uses the overall guidance setting.

settings.label: Guiding trails
settings.description: Glowing trails, breadcrumbs or companion pointers toward the goal. 'Follow' uses the overall guidance setting.

settings.label: Interaction highlights
settings.description: Glow or outline on objects you can use. 'Follow' uses the overall guidance setting.

settings.label: Objective marker
settings.description: Shows where your current objective is.

settings.label: HUD
settings.description: Minimal hides non-essential HUD elements. Custom lets you choose each element. Off hides the HUD; status is available on demand and captions are controlled separately.

settings.label: Hidden HUD elements
settings.description: Comma-separated HUD element ids hidden when HUD is set to Custom (for example: minimap,damage_numbers,quest_tracker).

settings.label: Visual effects density
settings.description: Reduces decorative particles, debris and weather. Hazards stay visible.

settings.label: Notifications
settings.description: Limits pop-ups. Everything is still kept in the log.

settings.label: Spider appearance
settings.description: 0 = original. 1 = no hair or fangs. 2 = no legs, simplified body. 3 = replaced with a non-spider shape and sounds. Attacks and hitboxes are unchanged.

settings.label: Blood
settings.description: Reduces or removes blood splatter, pools and wounds. Hit feedback is kept.

settings.label: Gore and dismemberment
settings.description: Reduces or removes dismemberment, exposed injuries and graphic corpse detail.

settings.label: Jump scares
settings.description: Reduced softens sudden loud stings and camera snaps. Scare warnings are set separately.

settings.label: Warn before jump scares
settings.description: Shows and announces a short, consistent heads-up before scripted scares. Works with full or reduced scares.

settings.label: Content warnings
settings.description: Shows a short notice before scenes with listed sensitive content, with time to pause, change settings or continue.

settings.label: Offer sensitive-scene skip
settings.description: Lets you skip a scene listed in the content notices, with a short text summary so you keep the story.

settings.label: Hold actions
settings.description: Toggle lets you press once to start and once to stop actions such as aim, sprint, crouch and block.

settings.label: Repeated presses
settings.description: Replaces rapid button presses with holding the button, or with a single press.

settings.label: Quick-time events
settings.description: Slow gives much more time for prompts. Auto completes them for you.

settings.label: Timing windows
settings.description: Makes timed actions (parry, dodge, perfect hits, rhythm notes) easier to hit.

settings.label: Aim slowdown
settings.description: Slows the aim while it is over a target. Pull and stabilisation are set separately.

settings.label: Aim pull
settings.description: Gently pulls the aim toward a nearby target.

settings.label: Aim stabilisation
settings.description: Smooths small unintended input movement and reduces recoil and sway while aiming.

settings.label: Target lock
settings.description: Locks the aim onto the nearest or selected target until you switch or release it.

settings.label: Look sensitivity
settings.description: How fast the camera turns.

settings.label: Invert vertical look
settings.description: Pushing up looks down.

settings.label: Game speed
settings.description: Slows the whole game, giving more time to react. Menus and subtitles are unaffected.

settings.label: Damage taken
settings.description: How much damage enemies and hazards deal to you. 0% means combat damage cannot hurt you. Falling is set separately.

settings.label: Safe falls
settings.description: Falling into pits or off ledges returns you to the last safe spot without losing progress.

settings.label: Infinite ammo
settings.description: Ammo is never used up.

settings.label: Infinite stamina
settings.description: Sprinting, climbing and dodging never run out.

settings.label: Enemy aggression
settings.description: How often enemies attack and how quickly they notice you. 0% means enemies never attack.

settings.label: Time limits
settings.description: Extended doubles countdowns. Off removes time limits that are not part of a race.

settings.label: Offer skip for puzzles and challenges
settings.description: Lets you skip a puzzle, chase or challenge from the pause menu, keeping all rewards. Also offered after a few retries; you can dismiss the offer.

settings.label: Random encounters
settings.description: How often random battles happen. 0% turns them off; story battles still happen.

settings.label: Auto-battle
settings.description: Party members choose sensible actions on their own. You can take control at any time.

settings.label: Battle animation speed
settings.description: Speeds up battle animations. Decision time is unaffected.

settings.label: Menu narration
settings.description: Reads menus, buttons and values aloud. Turns on automatically if a screen reader is running.

settings.label: Narration speed
settings.description: How fast narration speaks.

settings.label: Read dialogue aloud
settings.description: Reads unvoiced dialogue and notes aloud.

settings.label: Objective reminder
settings.description: Shows your current goal when you press the reminder button, or every few minutes.

settings.label: Story recap on load
settings.description: Shows a short 'Previously' summary of what has happened when you continue a save.

settings.label: Hints
settings.description: Hints come in steps: nudge, clearer hint, solution. On request shows them only when you ask.

settings.label: Pause when the window loses focus
settings.description: Pauses the game automatically if you switch to another window.

settings.label: Show active assists in HUD
settings.description: Optional reminder of which gameplay adjustments are on. Never shown on saves, endings or scores.
